title: phaseoloides caeruleum
intro: Phaseoloides caeruleum, commonly known as Blue Bean or Blue Lupin, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Phaseoloides caeruleum are attributed to its ability to act as an estrogen receptor modulator and to its antioxidant properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Phaseoloides caeruleum include isoflavones, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
